## Education

```{r}
#| output: asis
educ <- read_delim(
  file = "data/education.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "WINDOWS-1252"),
  delim = ";", 
  escape_double = FALSE, 
  col_types = cols(start = col_date(format = "%d/%m/%Y"), 
                   end = col_date(format = "%d/%m/%Y")), 
    trim_ws = TRUE)

educ |>
  format_date(end = "end") |>
  resume_entry(title = "degree", 
               description = "institution", 
               details = c("detail1", "detail2"))

```
